subject: general
question: As of February 2025, how many athletes trained under Khelo India have set international records?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1424**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• As of February 2025, **1,424 athletes** trained under the Khelo India initiative have set international records.
 
• The Khelo India program was launched by the Government of India in **2018** to promote sports culture and identify young talent nationwide.
 
• The initiative aims to provide **financial support, training, and infrastructure** to budding athletes across the country.
 
• It focuses on both grassroots-level development and nurturing the potential of elite athletes to achieve global recognition.
 
• The program has contributed significantly to India’s growing success in international sports events like the Asian Games and the Olympics.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Khelo India Scheme**

 
 
• The program is implemented by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, Government of India.
 
• It includes initiatives like Khelo India Youth Games (KIYG) and Khelo India University Games (KIUG) to foster competitive sports.
 
• Under the Talent Identification and Development program, selected athletes receive an annual scholarship of **₹5 lakh for 8 years**.
 
• The scheme also aims to improve sports infrastructure by upgrading facilities at schools, colleges, and universities.
 
 
 
• **India’s Rising Sports Achievements**
 
 
• India’s athletes have excelled in sports like badminton, wrestling, boxing, and shooting in recent years.
 
• The country secured its highest-ever medal tally in the **Tokyo 2020 Olympics** with 7 medals, including a gold in athletics.
 
 
 
• **Grassroots Sports Development**
 
 
• Programs like Khelo India emphasize identifying talent from **rural and underserved areas**.
 
• It aims to bridge the gap between urban and rural athletes, ensuring equal access to sports opportunities.
 
 
 
• **International Standards and Training**
 
 
• Under Khelo India, athletes are provided access to **world-class coaching** and training facilities.
 
• Partnerships with global sports organizations ensure exposure to international standards of competition.
